title: Drive Modes and Sport/Personal Settings
summary: Feedback centers on having multiple drive modes, with positive comments about enjoying mode selection and sporty feel, while many other mentions only note the feature without a clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the availability of different drive modes, especially sport mode, customization, and the ability to switch driving character.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention drive modes, adjustability, or intended future use without enough clear sentiment to classify them as positive or negative.

limitations: Many sampled mentions are brief feature references without explicit sentiment, which limits specificity.
One sampled fragment includes a negative-sounding remark about artistic drive modes being a gimmick, but it is assigned undetermined and cannot be used as negative evidence.
Examples are limited to US G60 reviews and are sentiment-stratified rather than representative.
